selector.rationale: Lipoma is supported by ultrasonography showing a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion, consistent with a lipoma, and the presence of a mobile, submucosal mass with smooth mucosal surface

rejected.label: Ectopic lymph node
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence supporting ectopic lymph node, such as lymphoid tissue on histopathology
